title: onboard-mantle-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Priya Kapoor
description:
Onboard Mantle-13B v1.0 into the model registry with metadata, performance profiles for our supported GPU families, and changelog/release-note automation hooks. Motivation: Mantle-13B is a high-quality open decoder released upstream; customers requested a Redwood-verified performance profile and model card so it can be safely used in Dedicated and Private deployments.

This PR includes: 
- model metadata (name, architecture, tokenizer, license, recommended config)
- model card and short examples for docs site
- perf profiles (p50/p95 latency, throughput, memory estimates) for A100-80GB, A40-48GB, and RTX6000 families, with quantization recommendations (FP16 / 4-bit where applicable)
- changelog automation entry so releases include a generated note when the model is published
- CI additions and unit tests for metadata validation and perf-profile schema

Checklist:
- [x] Add model metadata and model card
- [x] Add perf profiles for supported hardware and quantization tiers
- [x] Add changelog automation mapping and templates
- [x] Add unit tests and CI job updates
- [x] Run local evals and spot-checks against production harness

Testing and validation:
- Ran model onboarding smoke harness on a dedicated A100 test pool (10 warmup requests, 100 synthetic prompts) and captured latency/throughput numbers inserted into perf_profiles.yaml.
- Metadata validated with the existing schema (tests added to tests/model_registry/test_metadata_validation.py).
- Changelog automation tested by running scripts/changelog_automation/run_onboard_changelog.py against the new entry and verifying generated markdown matches expectations.

Rollout plan:
- Merge to main to trigger registry publishing pipeline.
- Add to internal docs and tag Redwood verified in the model catalog.
- Monitor performance and errors from canary traffic for 48 hours; fallback policy configured to route to aurora-13b-lite if memory/throughput anomalies observed.

Notes:
- Perf numbers are conservative; customers with different sequence-length distributions should run quick profiling scans (script included) before committing to quantized configurations.
- License: Apache-2.0 (confirmed).

References: Linear ENG-3141 for onboarding coordination; SUP-4821 for the customer request that initiated this work.
